Topic 3.7: READING Recognition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about READING Recognition. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Recognize letters of the incorporated in children’s play to alphabet in lower case in and enhance letter recognition. out of class. •

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Recognize letters of the incorporated in children’s play to alphabet in lower case in and enhance letter recognition. out of class. •
   In simple words: practise until you can recognize letters of the incorporated in children’s play to alphabet in lower case in and enhance letter recognition. out of class. •. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about READING Recognition using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about READING Recognition in the examples.
2. Explain READING Recognition to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand READING Recognition.
4. Show that you can: Recognize letters of the incorporated in children’s play to alphabet in lower case in and enhance letter recognition. out of class. •

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about READING Recognition using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is READING Recognition important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
